title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Komuna Parisit!
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 2+1 per shitje ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara per banim ne Tirane,
Apartamenti ndodhet ngjit me Kristal Center, ne nje objekt te viteve 2000, me ashensor dhe sistem kapot, ne katin e trete.
Organizohet ne nje sallon te bollshem ndenje, nje ambjent gatimi e ngrenie totalisht i vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi te bollshme, korridor shperndares, nje tualet, dhe dy ballkone.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Municipality of Paris!
description_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale in one of the most preferred residential areas in Tirana, the apartment is located next to the Kristal Center, in a building from the 2000s, with an elevator and hood system, on the third floor. It is organized in a spacious living room, a completely separate kitchen and dining area, two spacious bedrooms, a distribution corridor, a toilet, and two balconies.
